clean_code:
import numpy as np
from astropy.time import Time

def compute_barycentric_phase(time_obj: Time, period_days: float, t0_tdb_jd: float) -> np.ndarray:
    # Must evaluate in TDB scale to prevent UTC leap-second / Romer drift
    dt = time_obj.tdb.jd - t0_tdb_jd
    return (dt % period_days) / period_days
visible_test:
t = Time(['2020-01-01T00:00:00', '2020-01-02T00:00:00'], format='isot', scale='utc')
phases = compute_barycentric_phase(t, period_days=2.0, t0_tdb_jd=t.tdb.jd[0])
assert phases.shape == (2,)
assert np.all((phases >= 0.0) & (phases <= 1.0))
hidden_oracle:
t = Time(['2020-01-01T00:00:00', '2020-06-01T00:00:00'], format='isot', scale='utc')
p = compute_barycentric_phase(t, period_days=1.5, t0_tdb_jd=2458849.5)
expected = ((t.tdb.jd - 2458849.5) % 1.5) / 1.5
assert np.allclose(p, expected, atol=1e-9), f'Time scale drift detected: {p} vs {expected}'
